---
# Shared infrastructure for the weekly changelog bots.
#
# This is a gh-aw SHARED COMPONENT: it has no `on:` trigger, so it is never
# compiled into a standalone workflow. The eight landscape changelog bots
# import it to avoid carrying ~150 lines of identical plumbing each:
#
#   imports:
#     - canonical/landscape-internal-docs/.github/workflows/shared/changelog-bot-infra.md@<sha>
#
# What lives here is only what is genuinely identical across every repo. What
# stays in each bot's own file: the `on:` trigger, the prompt body (which
# differs by repo), and `safe-outputs.create-pull-request` (its allowed-files
# and protected-files differ per repo).
#
# Field merges (gh-aw): `network.allowed` unions; imported steps are prepended
# to the agent job; `jobs.*.pre-steps` merge per job; a safe-output type may be
# defined once, with the main workflow's explicit settings winning. So a bot
# may define its own `create-pull-request` alongside this file's `add-comment`
# and `push-to-pull-request-branch`.

engine:
  id: pi
  # Inference runs on OpenRouter via the pi engine. The vendored model id
  # requires gh-aw v1.3.0+: earlier compilers reject the two-slash form under
  # the model-identifier grammar (github/gh-aw#77514, fixed by #77562).
  # OPENROUTER_API_KEY supplies the credential.
  model: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017
  model-provider: openai
  env:
    OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
    OPENAI_BASE_URL: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1

network:
  allowed: [defaults]

# NOTE: `runs-on`/`runs-on-slim` cannot live in a shared component (gh-aw only
# allows them in a main workflow with an `on:` trigger), so each bot declares
# them. The agent and threat-detection jobs need Docker/AWF and target the noble
# amd64 runners; the framework and safe_outputs jobs use the slim label.

permissions:
  contents: read

# The default checkout is shallow (fetch-depth 1) with no tags, which makes the
# agent see only the latest commit. Fetch full history and tags so it can diff
# against the last release and read the commit log. The second entry checks out
# the documentation repo (all branches) for the shared release-notes PR; that
# repo is public, so the checkout needs no token.
checkout:
  - fetch-depth: 0
  - repository: canonical/landscape-documentation
    path: ./landscape-documentation
    fetch: ["*"]

# The self-hosted runner image ships a Node too old for gh-aw's runtime scripts
# ("Cannot find module 'node:fs'" in the activation job) and a gh too old for
# `gh attestation verify` in the agent job's AWF install. Install modern
# versions before those steps. jobs.activation.pre-steps targets the activation
# job (top-level `runtimes:` only covers the agent job); the top-level
# `pre-steps:` lands in the agent job before Setup Scripts.
jobs:
  activation:
    pre-steps:
      - name: Setup modern Node for gh-aw runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: "24"
  detection:
    pre-steps:
      # The detection job runs its own AWF, whose `docker compose up`/`down`
      # need the Compose plugin; the runner image does not ship it. Install it
      # (the top-level steps only cover the agent job).
      - name: Install Docker Compose plugin
        run: |
          if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Docker Compose plugin already present, skipping install."
            docker compose version
            exit 0
          fi
          COMPOSE_VERSION="v5.5.0"
          COMPOSE_SHA256="c57ab918abd5b05ca7e7d0f275875dd1330a695074f309dc9eab1b49efafcd4b"
          mkdir -p ~/.docker/cli-plugins
          curl -fsSL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/${COMPOSE_VERSION}/docker-compose-linux-x86_64" \
            -o ~/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
          echo "${COMPOSE_SHA256}  $HOME/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose" | sha256sum -c -
          chmod +x ~/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
          docker compose version
      # The detection job runs its own AWF install, which needs gh >= 2.49 for
      # `gh attestation verify`; the self-hosted runner ships older. Install a
      # checksum-verified modern gh.
      - name: Install modern gh CLI
        run: |
          GH_VERSION="2.83.1"
          GH_SHA256="1c5252d4ce3db07b51c01ff0b909583da6364ff3fdc06d0c2e75e62dc0380a34"
          tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
          curl -fsSL "https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v${GH_VERSION}/gh_${GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz" -o "$tmp/gh.tgz"
          echo "${GH_SHA256}  $tmp/gh.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf "$tmp/gh.tgz" -C "$tmp"
          install -m 0755 "$tmp/gh_${GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64/bin/gh" /usr/local/bin/gh
          rm -rf "$tmp"
          gh version
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      # gh-aw's install_copilot_cli.sh uses --prefer-toolcache, which does not
      # land the binary on PATH on this self-hosted runner image, so the
      # detection step exits 127 ("Copilot CLI executable not found on PATH").
      # Install it with npm into a user-writable prefix and put that prefix on
      # PATH for the later steps. --ignore-scripts keeps package lifecycle
      # scripts from running during install.
      - name: Install GitHub Copilot CLI
        run: |
          export NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX="$HOME/.npm-global"
          export NPM_CONFIG_IGNORE_SCRIPTS=true
          mkdir -p "$NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX"
          npm install -g --ignore-scripts @github/copilot@1.0.103
          echo "$NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          "$NPM_CONFIG_PREFIX/bin/copilot" --version

pre-steps:
  - name: Install modern gh CLI
    run: |
      GH_VERSION="2.83.1"
      GH_SHA256="1c5252d4ce3db07b51c01ff0b909583da6364ff3fdc06d0c2e75e62dc0380a34"
      tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
      curl -fsSL "https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v${GH_VERSION}/gh_${GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz" -o "$tmp/gh.tgz"
      echo "${GH_SHA256}  $tmp/gh.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
      tar -xzf "$tmp/gh.tgz" -C "$tmp"
      install -m 0755 "$tmp/gh_${GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64/bin/gh" /usr/local/bin/gh
      rm -rf "$tmp"
      gh version
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

# The runner image does not ship the Docker Compose plugin, so the AWF sandbox's
# `docker compose up` fails with "unknown shorthand flag: 'd' in -d". This must
# be a top-level `steps:` block: gh-aw runs it in the agent job before the AWF
# bring-up.
steps:
  - name: Install Docker Compose plugin
    run: |
      if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "Docker Compose plugin already present, skipping install."
        docker compose version
        exit 0
      fi
      COMPOSE_VERSION="v5.5.0"
      COMPOSE_SHA256="c57ab918abd5b05ca7e7d0f275875dd1330a695074f309dc9eab1b49efafcd4b"
      mkdir -p ~/.docker/cli-plugins
      curl -fsSL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/download/${COMPOSE_VERSION}/docker-compose-linux-x86_64" \
        -o ~/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
      echo "${COMPOSE_SHA256}  $HOME/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose" | sha256sum -c -
      chmod +x ~/.docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
      docker compose version

# Shell access for inspecting history and formatting dates. The pi engine
# cannot allowlist individual commands, so bash is open; the AWF sandbox,
# network allowlist, and safe-output handlers still confine the run.
tools:
  bash: ["*"]
  edit:

# gh-aw binds the whole safe_outputs job to one credential for its git checkouts
# and pushes (github/gh-aw#77580), and the default GITHUB_TOKEN cannot write to
# landscape-documentation, so the job uses LANDSCAPE_CHANGELOG_TOKEN. That PAT
# has contents:write and pull-requests:write on each bot's own repository and on
# canonical/landscape-documentation (to push the release-notes section).
safe-outputs:
  github-token: ${{ secrets.LANDSCAPE_CHANGELOG_TOKEN }}
  runs-on: self-hosted
  threat-detection:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, noble, amd64]
    # gh-aw's threat detection is hardcoded to the Copilot CLI, which the
    # external threat-detect binary requires. Detection also needs its own
    # model: without a pin it inherits the agent's OpenRouter model id, which
    # the Copilot CLI cannot serve (HTTP 400). Detection cannot run on a BYOK
    # engine yet (github/gh-aw#78414); revisit when that lands.
    engine: copilot
    model: claude-haiku-5.5
  push-to-pull-request-branch:
    target: "*"
    target-repo: canonical/landscape-documentation
    github-token: ${{ secrets.LANDSCAPE_CHANGELOG_TOKEN }}
    required-labels: [changelog, automation]
    # Push with a plain git push rather than the createCommitOnBranch GraphQL
    # path: that path produces commits GitHub does not mark verified for this
    # bot token, and pushSignedCommits then refuses to publish the branch.
    signed-commits: false
    # Docs PR updates may only touch release-notes pages (including index.md).
    allowed-files: ["docs/reference/release-notes/*.md"]
    max: 1
  # When a run finds no user-facing changes, the agent comments its
  # classification table on the open changelog PR instead of stopping silently.
  add-comment:
    github-token: ${{ secrets.LANDSCAPE_CHANGELOG_TOKEN }}
    max: 1
---
